listing.name: Taiko no Tatsujin (System 357 Green) — TaikoGreenRecomp (R19988088)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project claims native initialization, original-data access, gameplay and cabinet security/I/O support. USB camera NG and card support are unimplemented. Windows and Linux source targets are documented; Portcove has not tested a cabinet or physical controller. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own System357 SCEEXE001/S111 Green; exact dump/security version unknown.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build locally from your own SCEEXE001/S111Green dump with the pinned ps3recomp and SDL_GPU tools to generate an ELF native runtime. The development Windows command through Wine is separate from a native Linux build. The standalone taiko_release embeds your process image; keep it local while distribution permission remains under review.

warnings: The project claims native initialization, original-data access, gameplay and cabinet security/I/O support. USB camera NG and card support are unimplemented. Windows and Linux source targets are documented; Portcove has not tested a cabinet or physical controller.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
